head: Name / place
Fact
rows: Refused to fire at Peshawar (==**Chandra Singh Garhwali**==)
Crushed by foreign-cloth lorry, Bombay, **12 Dec 1930**

boxes.title: Women: added
items: CDM: women joined ==**in massive numbers**==; picketing liquor and foreign-cloth shops
**Sarojini Naidu**: first Indian woman INC president (**Kanpur 1925**)
**Maganti Annapurna** gave all her jewellery; **Duvvuri Subbamma** jailed
Jailed: **Bharati Devi Ranga**, **Digumarti Janakamma**, **Khammampati Manikyamba** (with baby)

boxes.title: Pact & sayings: added
items: Pact also: ==**peaceful picketing**==; ordinances withdrawn, fines remitted, unsold lands returned
Karachi resolutions drafted by **Jawaharlal Nehru**; youth disillusioned
Songs: **Bharata Swarajya Yuddham** (**Jagganna Sastri**); jail songs by **Adavi Bapiraju**
**K. Kamaraj**: first jailed in Rajaji's ==**Vedaranyam**== Salt Satyagraha

boxes.title: Also note
items: CDM = first **mass law-breaking**; brought the ==**NWFP**== into the struggle
Red Shirts = **Khudai Khidmatgars** of NWFP **Pathans**; Ghaffar Khan = "**Frontier Gandhi**"
